text: When you design a REST API, you should follow some simple rules to make it easy to use. First, give your endpoints clear and meaningful names, like /users or /orders. Use the correct HTTP methods and always return proper status codes, such as 200 for success or 404 when something is not found. Good documentation is also very important, because developers need to understand how your API works. Finally, use versioning, for example /v1/users, so you can improve your API without breaking existing applications.
